welcomeDescription: Connect to Yonix to build, check and update NixOS.
tokenNote: A verified token is saved for this panel origin and cleared when you disconnect.
whatToDo: What would you like to do?
buildDescription: Build the system without applying it
historyNote: History is saved on the host
logHint: Select an operation to view its log.
noJobs: No operations yet. Start by checking the configuration.
confirmSwitch: The system configuration will be built and applied. Services may restart.
confirmRollback: The previous NixOS generation will be activated.
confirmClean: Old generations will be deleted according to the configured retention period. Unused Nix store paths will be collected.
confirmUpdate: The flake.lock file in the configuration repository will be updated. The system will not be applied.
checkingSafe: Checking and building do not change the running system.
fullLogs: Last 128 KiB · full logs are saved on the host
connectionError: Cannot reach Yonix. Check the service or SSH tunnel.
desktopWorking: An operation is running. The log updates automatically.
desktopReady: Ready. Start by checking the configuration.
cacheDescription: Other hosts can reuse matching builds after trusting this public key.
authenticationHelp: The access token is missing or invalid. Enter the token for this Yonix instance.
connectionAddressHelp: Enter the private LAN or VPN address of another Yonix host.
connectionTokenHelp: Run yonix token on the other host and paste its 64-character token.
connectionStorageHelp: The token is saved privately on this gateway and is not returned to the browser.
connectionAdded: Host added. It is now available in Managed host.
noConnectionsHelp: Add a host using its address and access token.
connectionManagedByNix: Managed by Nix · edit programs.yonix.peers in the configuration.
removeConnectionHelp: Remove this host from the panel? Operations already running on it will continue.
tokenStorageError: The browser could not save the token. This session will remain connected until the page closes.
